identity.name: Happy Brains Pre School
identity.tagline: Little Steps Today, Bright Futures Tomorrow!
identity.about: Happy Brains Pre School is a caring space where young children are known by name, encouraged to ask questions, and given room to be themselves. We offer early education and daycare for young children in a warm, safe and stimulating environment.

address.formattedFull: 12th Main Road, 4th Block, Near Green Glen Park, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560034

programs.name: Playgroup
programs.description: Early social interaction, sensory exploration and gentle classroom familiarisation.

programs.name: Nursery
programs.description: Foundational language, numbers, creativity and motor skills through play.

programs.name: LKG
programs.description: Early literacy and numeracy, creative activities and school-readiness skills.

programs.name: UKG
programs.description: Communication, early academic concepts, independence and primary-school readiness.

daycare.description: Supervised care, play, rest and age-appropriate activities during working hours.
daycare.facilities: Dedicated nap room, child-safe cribs, freshly prepared meals, sanitary handwashing stations, indoor sensory play

approachAndFacilities.teachingApproach: Play-based learning where games, blocks, sand, stories and songs turn every day into discovery.
approachAndFacilities.facilities: Spacious classrooms, creative art corners, reading nook, safe outdoor playground, cozy daycare nap room, hygienic child-height washrooms
approachAndFacilities.safetyMeasures: Supervised handover at pickup, controlled visitor entry, first-aid certified staff, safe rounded furniture, background-checked attendants
approachAndFacilities.foodAndNutrition: Nutritious morning and afternoon snacks, warm lunches, pure filtered drinking water, strict allergy awareness
approachAndFacilities.transportation: Safe, GPS-monitored school van service with female attendant on designated neighbourhood routes
approachAndFacilities.admissionProcess: 1. Contact the school via Call or WhatsApp; 2. Discuss age & program; 3. Arrange a school visit; 4. Review fees & documents; 5. Complete enrollment.
approachAndFacilities.documentsRequired: Child's birth certificate copy, 4 passport photos, vaccination card copy, address proof of parents
approachAndFacilities.schoolVisitInfo: School visits are welcomed Monday to Friday 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM by prior appointment.

testimonials.name: Priya & Rahul Raman
testimonials.text: Happy Brains Pre School has been a second home for our toddler. The educators are deeply patient and caring, and we see our daughter blossoming in confidence every single day.

testimonials.name: Ananya Deshmukh
testimonials.text: The daycare facility gives me complete peace of mind while at work. Clean, loving, and attentive staff who genuinely know every child's personality.

testimonials.name: Vikram & Sangeetha Nair
testimonials.text: From gentle separation in playgroup to confident reading in UKG, our son has truly loved waking up for school every morning.

faqs.question: What age groups does the preschool accept?
faqs.answer: We welcome children from 1.5 to 5.5 years for preschool programs, and 6 months to 6 years for our daycare facility.

faqs.question: Which preschool programs are available?
faqs.answer: We offer Playgroup, Nursery, LKG, and UKG programs, along with flexible half-day and full-day daycare options.

faqs.question: What are the school and daycare timings?
faqs.answer: Preschool operates from 9:00 AM to 12:30 PM. Daycare is open from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, Monday through Friday.

faqs.question: Is daycare available for working parents?
faqs.answer: Yes, dependable daycare is available with quiet nap arrangements, healthy snacks, supervised play, and verified guardian handover.
